body:
Just got bit by this one too.
It seems to be specific to the menu widget as far as I can tell.

Likely related - from what I can tell, all the other [filter type widgets](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#filters) seem to add their attributes to `SearchParameters.facets` or `SearchParameters.disjunctiveFacets`. The menu widget does NOT do this, though it seems to me it should just like the others.

I discovered this when I got an error when I tried to add a facetRefinement on an attribute I was using a menu widget with: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/2004
